title: Library requirements set by the documents

entities.title: Every library covers the example scenario catalog
entities.summary: Each library shows how it is used through two example suites of unit tests, UTV first and native first, covering every scenario in docs/example-tests.md.
entities.statement: Every library covers every scenario of docs/example-tests.md in its UTV-first suite, and in its native-first suite every scenario the language's standard API can express at all. Each test's doc comment says "Verifies that …" and "Compared with: …"; where the two sides agree the expected value is computed with the other side, otherwise it is a literal.
entities.rationale: An example that is a unit test runs with the library's normal test command and cannot drift from what the library does.
acceptanceCriteria: Every row of the catalog has a UTV-first test in every language.
Tests of partial operations assert the outcome's status and its diagnostic code, at least for month-end, dst-gap and dst-overlap.
UTV zone operations in the examples use conformance/rules/demo-zones.json through a shared fixture, never the host's tz database.

origin.description: The catalog, and AGENTS.md section 2, Examples are unit tests.

entities.title: Every library marks every side-by-side task
entities.summary: UTV-first tests that illustrate a task of docs/side-by-side.md are wrapped in BEGIN <task-id> / END <task-id> comments, and every library marks every one of the 18 tasks.
entities.statement: In the UTV-first suite of every library, the tests that illustrate each task id listed in docs/library-api.md §7 are wrapped in // BEGIN <task-id> … // END <task-id> (# in Python), so tools/side_by_side.py can lay them out across the five languages.
entities.rationale: The page shows one task in five languages side by side from code that is compiled and run, so it cannot drift.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/side-by-side.md has no Missing section: every task has code from all five languages. The check does not enforce this yet (tools/.dev/backlog.json, side-by-side-missing-tasks-pass).

entities.title: Tests each library must have
entities.summary: The 0.2 tests with every everyday fixture and its diagnostic codes, every text-form fixture, typed-layer tests and the two example suites.
entities.statement: Every library runs all of conformance/operations/everyday.json, checking statuses and expect.diagnostics codes; all of conformance/operations/text-form.json through parseText and formatText; at least one typed-layer test per row of the table in docs/library-api.md §2, plus ToString/Parse and ToJson/FromJson round trips and constructor rejection; and the example suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Each library's test command (AGENTS.md section 3) runs every fixture in both fixture files.
Each library has typed-layer tests for every row of §2.
